floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 6 reconfirmed; wall is a two-axis allocno-priority race (counter i beats accumulator sum on both loop-ref-count and live-length) forcing sum->$a3/i->$v1, the inverse of target. Permuter a

frontier.hypothesis: Directed permuter campaign from candidate.c closes the 6-token RA rename.
frontier.mechanism: All structure (frame, 14 insns, delay slots, opcode order) is already correct; only which of {sum,i} gets $v1 differs. This dense single-axis space is exactly what decomp-permuter closes; a byte-neutral C mutation may lift sum's allocno priority above i's without a dead use.
frontier.next_probe: Build target.o from asm/funcs/func_8004954C.s + permuter prelude at offset 0 (avoid whole-file offset noise); run tools/permuter_campaign.py with fresh-seed discipline, wait in-turn + harvest --stop before ending the turn; cheat-vet any sandbox-0 form before proposing.

frontier.hypothesis: A semantically-faithful post-loop use of i (== arg1 at exit) equalizes live_length so the allocno-number tiebreak picks sum(75) first.
frontier.mechanism: If i lived to the return like sum, priority becomes a near-tie and allocno-number order (sum=75 < i=76) allocates sum first -> sum gets $v1.
frontier.next_probe: Search for any faithful form using i post-loop that still emits subu v0,a2,a1 (i's reg != $a1, so likely impossible); measure to KILL. Expect dead-end — dead-use would be a cheat.

frontier.hypothesis: Raise sum's per-iteration ref count via a genuinely-motivated recompute to flip the freq term.
frontier.mechanism: sum loses partly on freq (2 loop refs vs i's 3); a faithful loop body referencing the accumulator more could flip it.
frontier.next_probe: Check whether any faithful body keeps the exact 'addu v1,v1,a0' loop bytes while adding a sum ref (likely none); otherwise feed the permuter as a seed variant.
